plan_work: Integrate HTTP3/WebTransport control and datagrams with the same identity, canonical handlers, operation store and media bindings; validate browser origins, token lifetime, session limits and transport capabilities; expose SDK discovery.
plan_verification: Browser and independent HTTP3 authentication, canonical commands, negotiated media and retained-state recovery; cross-origin/malformed/unauthorized datagram refusal without resource leaks.

requirements.requirement: Same identity, canonical handlers and operation Store
requirements.observation: Both signing algorithms; canonical signed authentication/commands, reconnect/native same-owner receipt parity and one durable mutation; current credential/key revocation retires the peer.

requirements.requirement: WebTransport control/datagrams retain actual media bindings
requirements.observation: Actual subscribed PCMU500Hz/250Hz duplex, persisted verified transport/Device bindings and original session.started facts; mixed native public SDK/WT routes decode before/after foreign-physical-handle rejection.
Missing/foreign/duplicate Origin and wrong mount refuse before authority with unchanged Store and drained resources; protected secure exact bounded configuration is validated.
Independent token3s/key600s and key3s/token600s both algorithms, current revocation and server-key expiry; both intake profiles close and expired startup refuses.

requirements.requirement: Validate shared physical and Session limits
requirements.observation: One native plus seven WT held/authenticated transports retain signed IO across ninth refusal, exact retired-slot reuse and another ninth refusal; one WT Session consumes the shared quota and native admission refuses without another Session/Connection.

Missing mandatory QUIC datagrams refuse before WT dispatch while healthy peers continue. Data-only Endpoint audio refusal preserves one failed record, response ACK,0effects and0Connections. Disabled WT retains native TLS/control and rejects h3.

requirements.requirement: Expose discovery suitable for the SDK
requirements.observation: Actual authenticated canonical-only GET and public SDK, current revoked bearer/cancellation, empty/bounded input, no-store, disabled/null/unrelated listener behavior, closed descriptor and declared/chunked8192-byte response limits. No automatic trust or media grant.

requirements.requirement: Browser and independent clients authenticate and exchange commands/media
requirements.observation: Both algorithms; independent HTTP3 and owned installed Chrome155 use explicit TLS/signing trust, actual negotiated subscribed datagrams and independent G.711 output decoding. Chrome consumes derived Local discovery contact.

Original create receipt survives physical reconnect and graceful/drop restart both algorithms. After authoritative media retirement, fresh WT and native readers recover the same completed media record with no new route or Store change; repeated3times per algorithm.

requirements.requirement: Malformed and unauthorized datagrams fail without leaked resources
requirements.observation: All6invalid/unallocated-handle datagrams are observed rejected before/after authentication with no accepted input/DB mutation/Connection. A third authenticated physical peer cannot borrow a live handle; original routes still decode. Actual decoded-media shutdown/drop and EOF retire physical peers/readers/bindings.

requirements.requirement: Local contact preserves address family and normal TLS identity
requirements.observation: Derived actual IPv4/bracketed IPv6 contact; normal WebPKI validates localhost/127.0.0.1/::1 and refuses foreign names/IPs. Browser now qualifies the derived IPv4 contact.
